exams.quote: Each applicant for licensure as a dentist shall be examined by the board or by a testing organization or an organization of one or more state boards formed for the purpose of conducting a standard clinical examination of candidates for licensure as dentists if the board has approved each such organization

interval_years.quote: Each license to practice as a dentist or dental hygienist issued by the board, shall expire on December 1 of the year specified by the board for the expiration of the license and shall be renewed on a biennial basis.

required.quote: The board shall require every licensee to submit with the renewal application evidence of satisfactory completion of a program of continuing education required by the board.

period_years.quote: The board shall require every licensee to submit with the renewal application evidence of satisfactory completion of a program of continuing education required by the board.

available.quote: The board, without examination, may issue a license as a dentist or dental hygienist to an applicant holding a license in another state upon compliance with the requirements of professional qualification and experience set forth in subsection (b).

requirements.value: Must have held a license in another state for 5 years, actively practiced dentistry for 5 years, completed equivalent national and clinical board exams, complied with CE requirements, and provide certificate from prior state licensing authority.
requirements.quote: Each applicant for licensure as a dentist under this section shall have held a license to practice dentistry in one or more other states of the United States for the five-year period immediately preceding the date of application and shall have engaged in the active practice of dentistry for at least five years prior to the date of application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining any license, money or other thing of value.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committed fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining any license, money or other thing of value;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitually used intoxicants or drugs rendering the person unfit for practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitually used intoxicants or drugs which have rendered such person unfit for the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Determined by the board to be professionally incompetent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: been determined by the board to be professionally incompetent;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed gross, wanton or willful negligence in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed gross, wanton or willful negligence in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed, allowed or permitted unlicensed persons to perform work constituting the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: employed, allowed or permitted any unlicensed person or persons to perform any work in the licensee's office which constitutes the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene under the provisions of the dental practices act;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully violated laws of the state relating to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene or rules and regulations regarding sanitation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: willfully violated the laws of this state relating to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene or the rules and regulations of the secretary of health and environment or of the board regarding sanitation;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in the division of fees or agreed to split fees for referral without patient knowledge.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in the division of fees, or agreed to split or divide the fee received for dental service with any person for bringing or referring a patient without the knowledge of the patient or the patient's legal representative

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed complicity with or allowed use of the dentist's name in conjunction with any person engaged in the illegal practice of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed complicity in association with or allowed the use of the licensed dentist's name in conjunction with any person who is engaged in the illegal practice of dentistry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude without sufficient rehabilitation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: been convicted of a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude in any jurisdiction and the licensee fails to show that the licensee has been sufficiently rehabilitated to warrant the public trust;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed, dispensed, administered or distributed a prescription drug in an excessive, improper or inappropriate manner outside the scope of dentistry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribed, dispensed, administered or distributed a prescription drug or substance, including a controlled substance, in an excessive, improper or inappropriate manner or quantity outside the scope of practice of dentistry or in a manner that impairs the health and safety of an individual;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed, purchased, administered, sold or given away prescription drugs for other than legal and legitimate purposes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribed, purchased, administered, sold or given away prescription drugs, including a controlled substance, for other than legal and legitimate purposes;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated or been convicted of any federal or state law regulating possession, distribution or use of any controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violated or been convicted of any federal or state law regulating possession, distribution or use of any controlled substance;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to pay license fees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to pay license fees;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Used the name 'clinic,' 'institute' or other title suggesting a public or semipublic activity without authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: used the name "clinic," "institute" or other title that may suggest a public or semipublic activity except that the name "clinic" may be used as authorized in K.S.A. 65-1435

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed conduct detrimental to the public health, safety or welfare as defined by board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committed, after becoming a licensee, any conduct which is detrimental to the public health, safety or welfare as defined by rules and regulations of the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent misrepresentation in the practice of dentistry, including fraudulent claims.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaged in a misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent misrepresentation in the practice of dentistry or on any document connected with the practice of dentistry by knowingly submitting any misleading, deceptive, untrue or fraudulent misrepresentation on a claim form, bill or statement, including the systematic waiver of patient co-payment or co-insurance;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to keep adequate records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to keep adequate records;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had a license revoked, suspended, or limited, or voluntarily surrendered a license after formal proceedings in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the licensee has had a license to practice dentistry revoked, suspended or limited, has been censured or has had other disciplinary action taken, has had an application for license denied, or voluntarily surrendered the license after formal proceedings have been commenced by the proper licensing authority or another state, territory or the District of Columbia or other country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to furnish the board or its investigators any information legally requested by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failed to furnish the board, or its investigators or representatives any information legally requested by the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisted suicide in violation of Kansas law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: assisted suicide in violation of K.S.A. 21-3406, prior to its repeal, or K.S.A. 21-5407, and amendments thereto

insurance_required.quote: A policy of professional liability insurance issued by an insurer duly authorized to transact business in this state shall be maintained in effect by each licensed dentist actively practicing in this state as a condition to rendering professional services as a dentist in this state

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person shall operate a mobile dental facility or portable dental operation in this state unless registered in accordance with this section.

definition_quote.value: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry: (a) Who performs, or attempts or professes to perform, any dental operation or oral surgery or dental service of any kind...
definition_quote.quote: A person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry: (a) Who performs, or attempts or professes to perform, any dental operation or oral surgery or dental service of any kind, gratuitously or for a salary, fee, money or other remuneration paid, or to be paid directly or indirectly

value: supplying artificial substitutes for natural teeth
construction, reproduction or repair of prosthetic dentures, bridges, plates or appliances
diagnosis and prescription for disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of the human teeth or jaws
correction of malformations of teeth or jaws
administration of anesthesia in connection with a dental operation
sedation and general anesthetics (with board permit)
methods_authorized.quote: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe drugs or medicine, perform such surgical operations, administer analgesia, local anaesthetics and use such appliances as may be necessary to the proper practice of dentistry. Dentists may be authorized by the board to administer sedation and general anaesthetics subject to rules and regulations

drug_authority.value: A dentist may prescribe drugs or medicine, administer analgesia, local anesthetics, and with board authorization, sedation and general anesthetics.
drug_authority.quote: A dentist shall have the right to prescribe drugs or medicine, perform such surgical operations, administer analgesia, local anaesthetics and use such appliances as may be necessary to the proper practice of dentistry. Dentists may be authorized by the board to administer sedation and general anaesthetics subject to rules and regulations concerning qualifications of such dentists as may be adopted by the board.

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The board shall have authority to issue sedation permits to administer sedation and general anaesthetics. The board may establish different requirements and qualifications based upon the type of sedation or general anaesthetics the dentist is authorized by the board to use.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: Any office of a dentist who is authorized by the board to administer sedation or general anaesthetics shall be subject to inspection by the board for purposes of determining if the dentist is in compliance with the board's rules and regulations.

specialist_license_available.quote: Upon application to the board of any licensed dentist in this state, the board may issue a certificate of qualification to such dentist authorizing the applicant to hold out, or to announce, to the public that such dentist is specially qualified in, or limits such dentist's practice to, or gives special attention to any one of the recognized branches of dentistry.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any dentist holding a certificate of qualification under this section of the act may announce the limitation of such dentist's practice by using such terms and in such manner as the board may approve

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: No dentist shall announce or hold out to the public that such dentist is a specialist, or is specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry, or as giving special attention to any branch of dentistry, or limiting such dentist's practice to any branch of dentistry, unless such dentist has complied with additional requirements established by the board, and has been issued a certificate of qualification authorizing such dentist to do so.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: The board shall designate by rules and regulations the procedures which may be performed by a dental hygienist under direct supervision and the procedures which may be performed under general supervision of a licensed dentist.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: Except as otherwise provided in this section, the practice of dental hygiene shall be performed under the direct or general supervision of a licensed dentist at the office of such licensed dentist.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: The board is authorized to issue to a qualified dental hygienist an extended care permit I or extended care permit II, or extended care permit III as provided in subsections (f), (g) and (h) of this section.

value: children participating in residential and nonresidential centers for therapeutic services
children in families receiving family preservation services
children in the custody of the secretary for children and families or commissioner of juvenile justice
children served by runaway youth programs and homeless shelters
children birth to five and children in public and nonpublic schools kindergarten through grade 12
children participating in youth organizations who are dentally underserved
persons at local health departments or indigent health care clinics
persons at federally qualified health centers, federally qualified health center look-alikes, or community health centers

persons 65 years and older in residential centers, adult care homes, subsidized housing, hospital long-term care units, state institutions, community senior service centers, elderly nutrition programs, or homebound persons qualifying for HCBS waiver
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: The practice of dental hygiene may be performed with consent of the parent or legal guardian, on children participating in residential and nonresidential centers for therapeutic services...on persons with developmental disabilities and on persons who are 65 years and older who live in a residential center

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: No person shall operate a mobile dental facility or portable dental operation in this state unless registered in accordance with this section.

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: The rules and regulations shall include, but not be limited to, requirements relating to...procedures for emergency follow-up care for patients

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Except as provided in K.S.A. 17-2706 et seq., and amendments thereto, no corporation shall practice, offer, or undertake to practice or hold itself out as practicing dentistry.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any dentist who shall use the services of any person...not licensed to practice dentistry in this state, to construct, alter, repair or duplicate any denture, plate, partial plate, bridge, splint, orthodonic or prosthetic appliance, shall first furnish such unlicensed person with a written prescription

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture or removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a practitioner of dentistry or fabricated pursuant to such practitioner's work order, shall be marked with the name or social security number, or both, of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Each dental hygienist who administers local anaesthesia regardless of the type shall have completed courses of instruction in local anaesthesia and nitrous oxide which have been approved by the board.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: Each dental hygienist who administers local anaesthesia regardless of the type shall have completed courses of instruction in local anaesthesia and nitrous oxide which have been approved by the board.

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Such unlicensed person shall retain the original prescription and the dentist shall retain a duplicate copy thereof for inspection by the board, or its agent, for two years.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dentist may utilize an assistant not licensed by the board in the administration and monitoring of nitrous oxide or oxygen, or both, if that person is certified in cardiopulmonary resuscitation

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: The board is authorized to issue to a qualified dental hygienist an extended care permit I or extended care permit II, or extended care permit III as provided in subsections (f), (g) and (h) of this section.
